info.description: Contract projection, not evidence of deployed routes. Internal signed callers only. API-key notation represents the signature header, not bearer-token authentication; shared domain API v0.2 exact method/path/body/nonce/time signing is mandatory. Queries are signed JSON bodies; query strings are forbidden.
